back: Data plus the rules about it in one object, changed only through methods that enforce the rules.
Internal by convention. Not enforced by Python.
Name mangling to _ClassName__name, to avoid subclass clashes. Not security.
A @property with no setter over an internal _field.

front: Never return what from a getter?
back: An internal mutable collection. Return a tuple or a copy.
Ask the object to do the work (withdraw) instead of reading its data and changing it yourself.
